items.title_zh: 预测智能体何时该推理？面向可靠性路由的行为压力测试
items.title_en: When Should Forecasting Agents Reason? Behavioral Stress Tests for Reliability Routing
items.summary_zh: 该研究在 ForecastBench 风格的二元预测任务上，把“是否检索、是否推理、是否采信市场先验、是否使用历史类比”当作可观测的智能体行为，而非隐藏的实现细节。其核心发现是机制选择依赖于数据来源：对某些数据生成过程，结构化历史类比明显占优，而市场类机制在另一些情形下的表现则另有不同（原文摘要在此处截断）。研究据此主张通过行为压力测试为不同情形路由更合适的预测机制，从而提升预测智能体的可靠性。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.28475v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Forecasting agents increasingly combine language-model reasoning, retrieval, ensembling, and calibration, but it remains unclear when each behavior should be trusted. We study this question on ForecastBench-style binary forecasting tasks, treating the choice to retrieve, reason, defer to a market prior, or use a historical analog as an observable agent behavior rather than a hidden implementation detail. Our central finding is that mechanism choice is source-dependent: structured analogs dominate for some data-generating processes, while market/c…
items.why_zh: 它把“何时推理”变成可测量、可路由的工程问题，有助于预测智能体在简单机制更可靠时避免过度自信。
items.why_en: It turns "when to reason" into a measurable routing problem, helping forecasting agents avoid overconfidence where a simpler mechanism works better.

items.title_zh: TW3Cast：仅凭训练集选型的冻结路由与轻调基础模型，跻身 GIFT-Eval 前三
items.title_en: TW3Cast: A Frozen Router of Lightly Fine-Tuned Foundation Models for Time-Series Forecasting on GIFT-Eval, Selected Entirely on the Training Split
items.summary_zh: TW3Cast 是一个时间序列预测系统，截至 2026 年 9 月 14 日，在 GIFT-Eval 基准上以平均 MASE 排名位列 130 个参赛条目的第 3 名。排在其前面的两个条目属于榜单的“智能体”类别，即使用智能体或语言模型进行推理、生成或选择预测的多步系统，而 TW3Cast 不使用任何智能体或语言模型。它的路由是一张在训练集上一次性计算后即被冻结的表，其专家模型则是在这些训练集上做过轻量微调的公开基础模型（摘要提到 97 个数据集/任务，此处原文截断）。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.28506v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: TW3Cast is a time-series forecasting system that reaches position 3 of 130 entries on the GIFT-Eval benchmark by mean MASE rank, as of 2026-09-14. The two entries above it belong to the leaderboard's agentic category, multi-step systems that use agents or language models to reason about, generate or select forecasts. TW3Cast runs no agent and no language model. Its selection is a table computed once on the training split and then frozen, and its experts are public foundation models lightly fine-tuned on those training splits. For each of the 97 d…
items.why_zh: 它表明不依赖智能体或大模型的简单冻结路由方案，也能在时间序列预测榜单上逼近智能体系统。
items.why_en: It shows a simple frozen-routing approach without agents or LLMs can come close to agentic systems on time-series forecasting.

items.title_zh: DEEPO：面向多模态大模型幻觉的双熵增强策略优化
items.title_en: DEEPO: Dual-Entropy Enhanced Policy Optimization for Hallucination in MLLMs
items.summary_zh: 论文指出，强化学习虽被广泛用于提升多模态大模型（MLLM）的推理能力，但其对幻觉的影响并不稳定，根源在于“从奖励到参数更新”的纠正链条上存在两处薄弱环节。在采样（rollout）层面，高语义熵的困难问题经常产生整组全错的样本，使组相对优势恰好退化为零，而这正是幻觉风险最高之处；在优化层面，模型“自信但错误”的 token 对梯度不可见。DEEPO 提出双熵增强的策略优化方法，针对这两点进行改进以抑制幻觉。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.28570v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) is widely used to sharpen reasoning in multimodal large language models (MLLMs), yet its effect on hallucination is uneven. We trace this to two weak points in the \emph{correction chain} from reward to parameter update. At the rollout level, hard queries---those with high semantic entropy---frequently produce unanimously wrong sample groups, collapsing the group-relative advantage to zero exactly where hallucination risk is highest. At the optimization level, confident-but-wrong tokens are gradient-invisible: a catego…
items.why_zh: 它直指强化学习训练中幻觉最难被纠正的两处机制性缺口，为降低多模态模型幻觉提供新思路。
items.why_en: It pinpoints two structural gaps where RL fails to correct hallucinations, offering a new route to reducing them in MLLMs.

items.title_zh: TWIST：面向对话记忆“干预质量”的基准，附人工验证的草稿对齐
items.title_en: TWIST: A Proposed Benchmark for Intervention Quality in Conversational Memory, with a Human-Validated Draft-Alignment
items.summary_zh: 现有长对话记忆基准多聚焦于召回与提示式知识更新，近期工作也开始研究用户信念的演化与记忆状态。TWIST 提出一套新的基准，用于衡量一个此前未被测量的属性——“干预质量”，即一个已部署的记忆系统通过自身的写入、召回与审核接口，能否在信念变化的节点上正确行动。该基准包含四条赛道，覆盖无提示的张力检测、依据记录审核即将发出的草稿、以当前信念作答同时保留被取代的历史等场景。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.28575v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Long-conversation memory benchmarks increasingly test recall and prompted knowledge updates, and recent work studies evolving user beliefs and memory state. TWIST is a proposed benchmark suite for a complementary, unmeasured property: intervention quality -- whether a deployed memory system, exercised through its own ingest/recall/vet surface, acts correctly at belief change points. Four tracks cover unprompted tension detection, vetting outgoing drafts against the record, answering with current beliefs while preserving supersession history, and…
items.why_zh: 它把“记忆系统何时该主动干预”变成可评估的指标，补齐了长期对话记忆评测中的一块空白。
items.why_en: It turns "when a memory system should intervene" into a measurable metric, filling a gap in long-term conversational memory evaluation.

items.title_zh: 用 AI 智能体驱动流行病模型：Epydemix Agent 框架
items.title_en: Driving Epidemic Models with AI Agents: the Epydemix Agent Framework
items.summary_zh: 研究者提出 Epydemix Agent Framework，这是叠加在开源 Python 库 Epydemix（用于随机分室流行病建模）之上的附加层，目的是让基于大语言模型的 AI 智能体能够更可靠地操作该建模工具。框架为 Epydemix 增加了四项面向智能体交互的能力，包括发现可用的模型与参数、对声明式情景设定进行预防性验证，以及通过相应流程执行建模任务（原文摘要在此处截断）。作者特别强调，基于大语言模型的智能体虽然能为科学软件提供便捷的自然语言接口，但可靠性并不会自动得到保证，因此需要在框架层面内置校验与约束机制。这一工作为科学计算软件接入 AI 提供了“验证优先”的思路。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.28692v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Artificial Intelligence agents based on large language models provide convenient natural language interfaces to scientific software, but reliability is not automatic. Here we introduce the Epydemix Agent Framework, an additive layer over Epydemix, an open-source Python library for stochastic compartmental epidemic modeling. The framework extends the library with four capabilities to facilitate interaction with an AI agent: discovery of available models and parameters, preventive validation of a declarative scenario specification, execution throug…
items.why_zh: 它展示了让大语言模型安全驱动科学计算软件的一种范式：在扩展能力的同时把可靠性校验内置于框架之中。
items.why_en: It illustrates a pattern for letting LLMs safely drive scientific software by building reliability validation into the framework rather than assuming it.

items.title_zh: 面向小型搜索智能体的可验证奖励强化学习
items.title_en: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards for Small Search Agents
items.summary_zh: 可验证奖励强化学习（RLVR）在数学、编程等奖励明确的问题上表现出色，但在奖励不那么清晰的场景是否同样有效仍是开放问题。“reason-over-search”这一配方把 RLVR 应用于开放域问答：由检索为答案提供依据，再通过与参考答案匹配来产生奖励信号。此前该配方主要在大模型上得到验证，在十亿参数以下的模型上仅能借助更大教师模型的蒸馏实现。本文直接在小模型（Qwen3.5……，原文摘要在此处截断）上测试该配方，检验小模型能否在不依赖蒸馏的情况下通过可验证奖励学会检索与推理。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.28765v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) performs well on problems with clear rewards, such as mathematics and coding, but whether it also works where the reward is less clear remains open. The reason-over-search recipe applies RLVR to open-domain question answering, where retrieval grounds the answer and a match against the reference supplies the reward. So far it has been demonstrated on large models, and below one billion parameters only with distillation from a larger teacher. We test the recipe on a small model. We train Qwen3.5…
items.why_zh: 若成立，说明小模型也能靠可验证奖励自主学习检索式推理，而不必依赖大模型蒸馏。
items.why_en: If it holds, small models can learn retrieval-based reasoning from verifiable rewards without relying on distillation from larger teachers.

items.title_zh: 人机协同的假设检验：成本感知的 AI 选择性打分与人工逐级升级
items.title_en: Human-AI-Powered Hypothesis Testing: Cost-Aware Selective AI Scoring and Sequential Human Escalation
items.summary_zh: 大语言模型正越来越多地被当作廉价“裁判”，用于评估输出、标注数据，以及判断系统是否达到预期质量标准。但作者指出，把 AI 判断用于正式的统计推断，与简单把它当作真值标签有本质区别：AI 评估可能存在偏差或噪声，而严格的假设检验需要显式控制第一类错误与第二类错误。为此，研究探讨如何将 AI 判断与选择性的人工核验结合起来，在最低成本下完成一次有效的假设检验。其思路是按需选择性地对部分样本引入人工验证，并在必要时逐级升级到人工处理。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.28859v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Large language models are increasingly used as inexpensive judges to evaluate outputs, label data, and assess whether a system meets a desired quality standard. Yet using AI judgments for formal statistical inference is fundamentally different from simply treating them as ground-truth labels: AI evaluations can be biased or noisy, and rigorous hypothesis testing requires explicit control of type-I and type-II errors. We study how to use AI judgments, together with selective human verification, to conduct a valid hypothesis test at minimum cost. W…
items.why_zh: 它回应了 AI 当“裁判”时的统计有效性问题，给出兼顾成本与错误率控制的可行方案。
items.why_en: It tackles the statistical validity of AI-as-judge, offering a way to control error rates while keeping costs low.

items.title_zh: Forecast-Dojo：可回放的 LLM 预测智能体评测与训练环境
items.title_en: Forecast-Dojo: Replayable Environments for Benchmarking and Training LLM Forecasting Agents
items.summary_zh: 研究者提出 Forecast-Dojo，一个可回放的环境，用于评测和训练大语言模型预测智能体。它把已经结算的预测市场问题与带有日期的新闻数据结合起来，让智能体研究某一事件，并在历史上连续的若干时间点反复给出预测。同一套任务与工具既支持重复评测，也支持收集训练交互，还能利用已记录的真实结果提供反馈，从而无需等待新事件结算。该环境包含 1,568 个 Polymarket 事件，按时间划分为训练期与评测期，并配有约 1880 万条（原文摘要在此处截断）相关数据。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.28876v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We introduce Forecast-Dojo, a replayable environment for benchmarking and training LLM forecasting agents. It combines resolved prediction-market questions with dated news, allowing agents to research an event and revisit their predictions at successive historical dates. The same tasks and tools support repeated evaluation, collection of training interactions, and feedback from recorded outcomes without waiting for new events to resolve. Forecast-Dojo contains 1,568 Polymarket events, split by time into training and evaluation periods, and 18.8M…
items.why_zh: 可回放的历史环境让预测智能体的评测与训练不再受事件结算周期限制，可反复利用同一批数据。
items.why_en: A replayable historical setup frees forecasting-agent evaluation and training from event-resolution cycles, allowing the same data to be reused.

items.title_zh: PFArena：面向蛋白质改造的语言模型基准
items.title_en: PFArena: Benchmarking Language Models for Protein Modification
items.summary_zh: 蛋白质改造需要在极其庞大的序列空间中搜索，而湿实验验证通量低、成本高昂。尽管蛋白质语言模型（PLM）、大语言模型（LLM）以及基于 LLM 的智能体在该领域都展现出潜力，但在贴近真实实验决策的各种设定下，它们的相对效果仍不明确。为填补这一空白，作者提出 PFArena 基准，包含四个受控的任务接口，覆盖单突变体生成与多突变体排序两类核心问题。该基准意在为不同计算范式提供可比较的评测标准，帮助判断何种方法在现实蛋白质改造决策中更有效。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.28921v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Protein modification requires navigating an immense sequence space, yet wet-lab validation remains low-throughput and costly. Although computational paradigms including protein language models (PLMs), large language models (LLMs), and LLM-based agents have shown promise in protein modification, their relative efficacy across realistic experimental decision-making settings remains unclear. To bridge this gap, we introduce PFArena, a benchmark comprising four controlled task interfaces that cover single-mutant generation and multi-mutant ranking. B…
items.why_zh: 它为蛋白质改造中的多种 AI 方法提供了统一、可控的对比评测，帮助判断哪种范式真正实用。
items.why_en: It offers a unified, controlled comparison of AI approaches for protein modification, clarifying which paradigm is actually useful.

items.title_zh: AlphaDiverse：面向多样探索的本地量化研究智能体后训练
items.title_en: AlphaDiverse: Post-Training Local Quantitative Research Agents for Diverse Exploration in Alpha Factor Mining
items.summary_zh: 基于大语言模型的多智能体系统可以自动挖掘 alpha 因子，但对外部 API 的依赖限制了成本控制、可用性与保密性。此外，长时间的研究循环往往反复回到少数成功过的经济机制，造成“研究路径坍缩”。为应对这些限制，作者提出 AlphaDiverse，一个整合三部分的框架：多智能体 alpha 研究系统、多样化研究路径收集，以及面向本地智能体的后训练。该框架让研究系统生成互补的方案组合，并通过对本地智能体后训练来提升探索的多样性，从而在无外部 API 依赖的前提下扩展搜索空间（原文摘要在此处截断）。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.29014v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Large language model (LLM)-based multi-agent systems can automate alpha factor mining, but their reliance on external APIs limits control over cost, availability, and confidentiality. Long research loops also tend to revisit a few successful economic mechanisms that lead to research path collapse. To address these limitations, we propose AlphaDiverse, a framework that integrates a multi-agent alpha research system, diverse research path collection, and post-training for local agents. We let the research system generate complementary plan portfoli…
items.why_zh: 它试图让量化因子的自动挖掘摆脱外部 API 依赖，并缓解研究路径收敛导致的探索不足。
items.why_en: It aims to free automated alpha mining from external API dependence and counter the exploration collapse caused by path convergence.

items.title_zh: CRISS：辅助肿瘤登记员的检索增强 AI 聊天机器人
items.title_en: CRISS: A Retrieval-Augmented AI Chatbot for Assisting Cancer Registrars
items.summary_zh: 肿瘤登记员，包括肿瘤数据专员（ODS），必须解读复杂且频繁更新的编码与分期标准。为此，作者开发了 CRISS（Cancer Registry Intelligent Support System），一个基于检索增强生成（RAG）的对话式助手，旨在提供快速、带引用支撑的登记指南获取途径。本研究评估 CRISS 能否做到三点：一是给出准确且有引用支撑的回答；二是改善相关指南的可及性与解读效率；三是支持培训与服务台场景，同时保持（原文摘要在此处截断，涉及保密或合规方面的要求）。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.29075v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Cancer registrars, including Oncology Data Specialists (ODSs), must interpret complex and frequently updated coding and staging standards. We developed CRISS (Cancer Registry Intelligent Support System), a retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) conversational assistant that provides rapid, citation-supported access to registry guidance. This study evaluated whether CRISS could (1) support accurate and citation-supported responses, (2) improve access to and interpretation of relevant guidance, and (3) support training/helpdesk use while preserving h…
items.why_zh: 它展示了 RAG 助手在高度专业化、标准频繁更新的医疗登记场景中的落地价值与评估方式。
items.why_en: It demonstrates the value and evaluation of RAG assistants in a highly specialized medical registry domain with frequently updated standards.

items.title_zh: 在 WeBe Band 上快速训练与部署机器学习模型的流水线
items.title_en: A Rapid Pipeline for Training and Deploying ML Models on WeBe Band
items.summary_zh: 为算力与内存受限的边缘设备开发优化过的机器学习算法既困难又耗时，且高度依赖具体设备的约束条件。为此，作者简化了边缘机器学习工作流，使机器学习模型能够直接在 WeBe Band 上快速开发、优化与部署——WeBe Band 是一款用于多模态生理数据监测的手腕可穿戴设备。该系统可自动生成硬件高效的机器学习模型，并便于集成到目标设备中（原文摘要在此处截断）。这一流程意在降低设备特定约束带来的开发门槛，加速可穿戴场景下的模型落地。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.29084v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Developing optimized machine-learning algorithms for edge devices with limited computational and memory resources is challenging, time-consuming, and highly dependent on device-specific constraints. In this work, we streamline an edge ML workflow to enable rapid development, optimization, and deployment of machine-learning (ML) models directly on the WeBe Band, a wrist-worn wearable device designed for multimodal physiological data monitoring. The proposed system automatically generates hardware-efficient ML models that can be easily integrated i…
items.why_zh: 它把设备约束纳入自动化流程，缩短了可穿戴健康设备上从模型到部署的周期。
items.why_en: By automating around device constraints, it shortens the path from model to deployment on wearable health devices.

items.title_zh: 先定范围再持久化：防止智能体记忆中的跨任务族干扰
items.title_en: Scope Before You Persist: Preventing Cross-Family Interference in Agent Memory
items.summary_zh: 持久记忆让语言模型智能体无需更新模型权重，就能改进提示与技能。该论文提出，只有当技能的检索范围与验证范围相匹配时，这些编辑才能在反复出现的任务族之间实现可靠的重复适配。研究在 ProcStream-RSI（一个 12 轮代码修复流）上考察冻结模型智能体，并使用以执行为判据的持久技能编辑门控方法 ORC（正交回归控制）。在一项固定候选方案与门控决策的干预实验中，只把每个已接受的技能检索用于其来源任务族，以检验跨任务族干扰的影响。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.29144v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Persistent memory lets language-model agents improve prompts and skills without updating model weights. We show that matching retrieval scope to certification scope enables these edits to support reliable repeated adaptation across recurring task families. We study frozen-model agents on ProcStream-RSI, a 12-round code-repair stream, using Orthogonal Regression Control (ORC), an execution-grounded gate for persistent skill edits. In an intervention that holds proposals and gate decisions fixed, retrieving each accepted skill only for its originat…
items.why_zh: 它指出智能体记忆的关键不只是“记住什么”，还在于技能的检索范围要与验证范围一致，否则会造成跨任务族干扰。
items.why_en: It shows that agent memory hinges not only on what is stored but on aligning retrieval scope with certification scope, lest skills interfere across task families.

items.title_zh: 熵三角方法（ETM）：基于逾万名患者数据的心律失常预测新框架
items.title_en: The Entropy Triangle Method (ETM): A novel framework for the prevention of cardiac arrhythmia with a review of more than 10,000 patients
items.summary_zh: 该研究提出“熵三角方法”（ETM），一个用于预测心律的新型机器学习框架，目标是提升医学预测能力。框架包含三步：特征工程、熵三角过采样与疾病预测。所用数据为包含 10,646 名患者的 12 导联心电图（ECG）心律失常研究数据库，涵盖 11 种心律（5 种窦性心律与 6 种非窦性心律）。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.29187v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: One of the most important problems in medicine is to facilitate prediction. In this study, we propose entropy triangle method, a novel framework for predicting heart rhythms using a novel machine learning technique. This framework includes three steps: feature engineering, entropy triangle oversampling, and disease prediction. The dataset used in this study is a 12-lead electrocardiogram (ECG) arrhythmia research database with 10,646 patients. This dataset contains 11 different heart rhythms (5 sinus rhythms and 6 non-sinus rhythms). In this arti…
items.why_zh: 它把熵特征与过采样结合用于大规模心电图数据，为心律失常的自动预测提供了新的技术路线。
items.why_en: It combines entropy-based features with oversampling on large-scale ECG data, offering a new route for automated arrhythmia prediction.

items.title_zh: Baszta：以数据为中心微调的波兰语多标签安全分类器
items.title_en: Baszta: Data-Centric Fine-Tuning of a Polish Multi-Label Safety Classifier
items.summary_zh: 研究者通过微调 allegro/herbert-base-cased（124M 参数），构建了覆盖仇恨、粗俗、性内容、犯罪与自残五个标签的波兰语内容安全分类器，训练目标为 Focal + R-Drop 组合损失。模型在共享的分布外 Gadzi Język 基准上与 Bielik Guard（Sójka）对比，两者都在同一校准集上做分类别阈值调优。在这种对齐的评测协议下，该模型在 micro F1 上取得小幅但统计显著的领先，而在 macro F1 上的表现则存在差异。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.29266v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We develop a multi-label Polish content-safety classifier by fine-tuning allegro/herbert-base-cased (124M) across five categories (hate, vulgarity, sexual content, crime, self-harm) using a Focal + R-Drop objective, and evaluate the resulting model against Bielik Guard (S\'ojka) on the shared out-of-distribution Gadzi J\k{e}zyk benchmark. Both systems are given per-category threshold tuning on the same calibration split. Under that matched protocol our model holds a small but statistically significant lead in micro F1, while an apparent macro-F1…
items.why_zh: 它表明在小语种、多标签安全审核场景中，数据与训练目标的精心设计可以取得优于既有守护模型的表现。
items.why_en: It shows that careful data-centric design and objectives can outperform established guard models in low-resource, multi-label safety moderation.

items.title_zh: ALOE：用于知识编辑的语义寻址低秩算子
items.title_en: ALOE: Semantically Addressed Low-Rank Operators for Knowledge Editing
items.summary_zh: 知识编辑既要“写入”新事实，也要解决“寻址”问题：决定哪些隐藏状态应接收新的残差更新。激活范围过窄会让模型只记住某一个提示，范围过宽则会干扰相邻知识。参数化编辑器隐式地编码这种作用范围，而基于记忆的编辑器虽然显式地做出选择，却把选择留在模型之外。ALOE 提出以语义寻址的低秩算子完成知识编辑，兼顾事实更新与邻近知识的保持。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.29269v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Knowledge editing changes what a model knows by modifying parameters so that a requested fact updates while unrelated behavior is preserved. This is usually treated as a write problem, but editing also involves an address problem: deciding which hidden states should receive the new residual. An update that activates too narrowly memorizes one prompt, while one that activates too broadly disrupts neighboring knowledge. Parametric editors encode this scope implicitly, whereas memory-based editors make the selection explicit but keep it outside the…
items.why_zh: 它把知识编辑的作用范围问题显式化，有望在更新事实的同时减少对无关能力的破坏。
items.why_en: By making the scope of an edit explicit, it aims to update facts without damaging unrelated model behavior.

items.title_zh: 从文本决策到像素决策：Jev 式视觉选择模型研究
items.title_en: From Text Decisions to Pixels: An Study of Jev-Style Visual Choice Model
items.summary_zh: 视觉软件常常需要在给定候选项中做出决策，而非生成解释。作者提出 PixelJev，一种原生图像决策接口，利用小型开源多模态模型，将图像、任务指令与运行时候选集映射为结构化选择以及以候选为条件的概率。其初步实现通过现有语言模型读出层统一了识别与多选视觉问答，并分别评估了冻结推理、语言侧适配与留出（held-out）三类选项的效果。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.29283v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Visual software often needs a decision over supplied alternatives rather than a generated explanation. We present PixelJev, a native-image decision interface that maps an image, a task instruction, and a runtime candidate set to a structured choice and candidate-conditioned probabilities using small open multimodal models. Its initial realization unifies recognition and multiplechoice visual question answering through an existing language-model readout, with separately evaluated options for frozen inference, language-side adaptation, and held-out…
items.why_zh: 它把“在候选中做选择”的决策式接口引入多模态模型，为需要结构化输出的视觉应用提供了新范式。
items.why_en: It brings a decision-style interface to multimodal models, offering a new paradigm for visual applications that need structured choices rather than free-form generation.

items.title_zh: 可穿戴心电质量评估：深度学习与动态情境感知方法
items.title_en: Wearable ECG Quality Assessment: A Deep Learning and Ambulatory Context-Awareness Approach
items.summary_zh: 该论文提出并评估了一种基于深度学习的信号质量评估（SQA）模型，用于区分干净与含噪的动态心电图（ECG）。模型在 CACHET-CADB 上训练，作者称该数据库是首个同时包含物理数据与患者自报情境数据的动态 ECG 数据库。模型在 MIT 系列数据库以及最新的 PhysioNet/CinC Challenge 2021 数据上表现出稳定性能。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.29396v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: This paper presents and evaluates a Deep Learning-based (DL-based) Signal Quality Assessment (SQA) model to distinguish between clean and noisy ambulatory Electrocardiograms (ECG). The model is trained on Copenhagen Center for Health Technology-Contextualized Arrhythmia Database (CACHET-CADB), which, to the best of our knowledge, is the first ambulatory ECG database with both physical and patient-reported contextual data. The model shows stable performance on different databases such as MIT-databases and the latest PyhsioNet/Cinc Challenge 2021 d…
items.why_zh: 可靠的质量评估是可穿戴心电监测落地的前提，情境感知信息有望提升噪声识别的稳健性。
items.why_en: Reliable quality assessment is a prerequisite for wearable ECG monitoring, and contextual information may improve robustness in noise detection.

items.title_zh: 直接问 Jev：以校准决策强化学习零样本检测 AI 对齐失效
items.title_en: Just Ask Jev: Reinforcement Learning for Calibrated Decisions as a Zero-Shot Detector of AI Alignment Failures
items.summary_zh: 检测对齐失效的模型用于筛查已部署的语言模型并为对齐基准打分，但多数是生成式评判器，每条标准都要耗费一次解码；像 Llama Guard 这类读取 token 概率的分类器，每次调用也只能给出一个固定标签。Jev 是经“校准决策强化学习”（RLCD）训练的模型，可在单次调用中对同一输入回答多个带类型的问题并给出校准概率，但其检测对齐失效的能力此前尚未被测量。作者为此提出 RLCDAlignBench 进行基准评测。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.29429v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Detectors of alignment failures screen deployed language models and score alignment benchmarks. Most are generative judges that spend a decoding pass on every criterion, and classifiers that read token probabilities, such as Llama Guard, still score one fixed label per call. Jev, a model trained with reinforcement learning for calibrated decisions (RLCD), answers many typed questions about one input with calibrated probabilities in a single call. Whether it detects alignment failures has not been measured. We present RLCDAlignBench, which benchma…
items.why_zh: 若能以单次调用给出多维度、带校准概率的对齐评估，将显著降低模型筛查成本并扩大覆盖面。
items.why_en: A single-call, calibrated multi-question evaluator could substantially cut the cost and broaden the coverage of alignment screening.

items.title_zh: SWE-Prometheus：衡量真实代码仓库的工程治理改进
items.title_en: SWE-Prometheus: Measuring Engineering Governance Improvements in Real-World Repositories
items.summary_zh: 基于大语言模型的编程智能体在仓库级软件工程任务上进展显著，但现有仓库基准通常从人类已定位的问题出发，只评估补丁是否满足某个功能信号。作者提出 SWE-Prometheus，面向更广泛的“改进仓库工程治理”任务：每项任务给出固定快照与开放式目标，要求智能体自行识别风险、排定干预优先级并验证改动结果。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.29465v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Large language model based coding agents have made substantial progress on repository-level software engineering tasks. Existing repository benchmarks, however, usually start from a human-identified issue and evaluate whether a patch satisfies a functional signal. We present SWE-Prometheus, a benchmark for the broader task of improving repository engineering governance. Each task provides a fixed snapshot and an open-ended objective, requiring the agent to identify risks, prioritize interventions, and verify the resulting changes. SWE-Prometheus…
items.why_zh: 它把评测从“修好一个已知 bug”扩展到自主发现并治理工程风险，更贴近真实软件维护场景。
items.why_en: It shifts evaluation from fixing a known bug to autonomously finding and governing engineering risks, closer to real-world maintenance.

items.title_zh: 延迟满足作为长时程 LLM 的多智能体生存微观基准：社会暴露、人格与工具使用预算
items.title_en: Delay-of-Gratification as a Multi-Agent Survival Micro-benchmark for Long-Horizon LLMs: Social Exposure, Personas, and Tool Use Budgets
items.summary_zh: 这篇论文提出一个受斯坦福“棉花糖实验”启发的多智能体生存微观基准，用来评测长时程 LLM 智能体的延迟满足能力。基准中的 ReAct 智能体按分钟推进，需要在多轮互动中维持目标、调用工具并与其他智能体打交道，同时考察社会暴露、人格设定与工具使用预算等因素。作者指出，现有研究缺乏可审计的多轮、多因素实验，难以量化 LLM 在明确约束下的行为，也缺少能揭示行为随时间如何展开的时间分辨统计。该基准正是为填补这一空白而设计。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.29509v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed as multi-turn agents that must sustain goals, use tools, and adapt to other agents over extended interactions. However, existing research lacks auditable, multi-turn, multi-factorial experiments that quantify LLM behavior under explicit constraints, with time-resolved statistics that reveal how behavior unfolds over long horizons. To address this gap, we develop a multi-agent micro-benchmark inspired by the Stanford marshmallow experiment: ReAct agents operate minute-by-minute with a "raise a…
items.why_zh: 为长时程、多轮 LLM 智能体提供了可审计、可复现的行为评测方式，填补了智能体长期行为量化研究的空白。
items.why_en: It offers an auditable, reproducible way to evaluate long-horizon multi-turn LLM agents, filling a gap in quantifying how agent behavior unfolds over time.

items.title_zh: 物理智能体的安全技能退役
items.title_en: Safe Skill Retirement for Physical Agents
items.summary_zh: 论文关注“物理智能体”的技能退役问题。智能体技能不仅包含操作流程，还捆绑着涉及权限、用户同意和实时环境状态的执行条件；当模型能力提升时，维护者往往会清理那些在授权基准任务上显得冗余的指令，但这些授权维护测试并不会触发处于休眠状态的安全条件。这种错配会在涉及物理后果与隐私敏感效果时形成未被测量的支持缺口。作者提出“匹配权限反事实”方法，在固定请求动作、工具参数与预期效果的前提下比较权限条件的变化，以揭示被忽视的安全风险。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.29543v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Agent skills bundle procedural guidance with execution conditions governing authority, user consent, and live environment state. When model capabilities advance, maintainers prune instructions that appear redundant on authorized benchmark tasks. However, authorized maintenance tests can leave dormant safety conditions untested. This mismatch creates an unmeasured support gap over physical and privacy-sensitive effects. We introduce matched authority counterfactuals that hold the requested action, tool parameters, and intended effect fixed while s…
items.why_zh: 揭示了模型能力升级后清理“冗余”技能指令可能带来的安全隐患，为物理与隐私敏感场景的智能体维护提供验证方法。
items.why_en: It exposes how retiring seemingly redundant skills after capability upgrades can silently remove safety conditions, offering a way to verify maintenance in physical and privacy-sensitive settings.

items.title_zh: ERRAND：智能体记忆的预算化维护
items.title_en: ERRAND: Budgeted Maintenance of Agent Memory
items.summary_zh: 论文指出，已部署的智能体往往依赖“交接时”的知识：一个冻结的策略只能查阅在数据流开始前写好的整合简报。但世界在变化而知识库静止不动——路径会封闭、标志会改变、价格区间会移动；每一条信息在交接时都为真，问题不是无知而是陈旧。作者提出 ERRAND，把“重新验证”视为一次有代价的差事：复核要与其所保护的任务争夺同样稀缺的行动预算，只有当消除某个疑问的“每次行动价值”超过某个运行中的工资阈值时，才值得为之付费。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.29545v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Deployed agents run on handed-over knowledge: a frozen policy consults a briefing of consolidated items written before the stream begins. The world then moves while the store stands still: paths close, flags change, price bands move; every item was true at handover, and the failure is staleness, not ignorance. We introduce ERRAND, which treats revalidation as a priced errand: a recheck competes with the task it protects for the same scarce actions, funded only when the value per action of resolving a doubt clears a running wage. The errand index…
items.why_zh: 把记忆更新建模为与任务争夺预算的经济决策，为长期部署智能体的知识陈旧问题提供了可操作的维护机制。
items.why_en: By framing memory revalidation as a budgeted economic decision competing with the task itself, it offers a practical mechanism for keeping deployed agents' knowledge from going stale.

items.title_zh: 跨模态情感理解：用 Transformer-GAT 进行对话情感识别
items.title_en: Cross-Modal Emotion Understanding: A Transformer-GAT Approach for Dialogue Emotion Recognition
items.summary_zh: 多模态情感识别是情感计算中的重要研究方向，可应用于情感分析、智能客服与人机交互。但现有方法多依赖单模态特征或简单的多模态融合，难以捕捉全局与局部上下文之间的协同关系，从而限制了模型性能与情感理解能力。为此，作者提出 Transformer-GAT 混合框架，将 Transformer 与图注意力网络（GAT）结合，实现跨模态的情感理解，以更好地建模对话中的情绪信息。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.29556v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Multimodal emotion recognition is a key research area in affective computing, with applications in sentiment analysis, intelligent customer service, and human-computer interaction. However, existing methods often rely on single-modal features or simple multimodal fusion, failing to capture the synergy between global and local contexts, which limits model performance and emotion understanding. To address this challenge, we propose Transformer-GAT, a hybrid framework that combines Transformer and the Graph Attention Network to enable cross-modal em…
items.why_zh: 提出结合 Transformer 与图注意力网络的混合框架，试图弥补多模态情感识别中全局与局部上下文协同建模不足的问题。
items.why_en: It combines Transformer and graph attention to better capture global-local context synergy, a known weakness in multimodal emotion recognition.

items.title_zh: 推理总是有用吗？重新审视通用多模态嵌入中的推理价值
items.title_en: Is Reasoning Always Useful? Rethinking Reasoning Utility in Universal Multimodal Embeddings
items.summary_zh: 推理增强的通用多模态嵌入（UME）能改善异构检索，但看似合理的推理过程未必带来更具判别力的排序结果。作者通过对比当前先进的推理式 UME 方法 UME-R1 中的判别分支（DISC）与推理驱动的生成分支（GEN），研究这一差距，并把推理的价值拆解为正样本增益、难负样本增益以及二者的边际差。结果显示，56.6% 的情况下正样本相似度上升，但也存在 15.7% 的“假帮忙”情形——推理反而把难负样本拉得更近。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.29560v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Reasoning-enhanced universal multimodal embeddings (UME) improve heterogeneous retrieval, but plausible rationales do not necessarily produce discriminative rankings. We study this gap by comparing the discriminative (DISC) and reasoning-driven generative (GEN) branches of UME-R1, a state-of-the-art reasoning UME method. We decompose reasoning utility into positive-target gain, hard-negative gain, and their margin difference. Positive similarity increases for 56.6%, but 15.7% are false-helpful cases where reasoning moves hard negatives closer eve…
items.why_zh: 量化了多模态检索中“推理可能帮倒忙”的现象，提醒研究者在嵌入模型中不能默认推理必然带来收益。
items.why_en: It quantifies when reasoning actively hurts retrieval, cautioning against assuming that reasoning always improves embedding models.

items.title_zh: iCoder-27B：以递归 AI 主导开发前沿工业编程模型
items.title_en: iCoder-27B: Recursive AI-Led Development of Frontier Industrial Coding Model
items.summary_zh: 递归 AI——即让 AI 越来越完整地参与构建与改进 AI——被视为“AI for AI”的明珠。尽管在小模型、有界任务和固定时间预算下，递归自我开发已具备可行性，但要真正做出一个可发布、具备前沿竞争力的模型，难度仍然大得多。本文追问：要让智能体开发出前沿模型，人类参与可以少到什么程度？作者把人类输入集中在高密度、低频率的环节，并在此基础上推进 iCoder-27B 这一前沿工业级编程模型的开发。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.29626v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Recursive AI, the prospect of AI taking an increasingly complete role in building and improving AI, is a crown jewel of AI for AI. Although recursive self-development has become practical for small models, bounded tasks, and fixed time budgets, a more consequential realization of this ambition, i.e., developing a release-ready, frontier-competitive model, remains far more challenging. In this work, we ask how little human involvement is sufficient for an agent to develop a frontier model. We concentrate human input into a high-density, low-freque…
items.why_zh: 探索把人类参与压缩到最小程度后，AI 能否自主开发出前沿级工业编程模型，直指递归自我改进这一核心命题。
items.why_en: It probes how far AI-led development can go toward a frontier industrial coding model with minimal human involvement, a central question for recursive self-improvement.

items.title_zh: 偏见中的金矿：以验证推动 AI 设计流程成熟
items.title_en: The Gold in Bias: Maturing the AI Design Process through Verification
items.summary_zh: 论文主张重新理解 AI 系统中的偏见。偏见通常被当作需要最小化的缺陷，但它同时也是数据、建模假设与系统设计存在深层弱点的关键指示器。现有做法往往把偏见视为孤立问题，而不是可用于强化 AI 全生命周期验证与治理的证据。作者试图把偏见重新定义为支持严格 AI 验证的诊断工具，并构建一个多维分析框架来剖析偏见，展示偏见在不同设计路径中是如何产生的。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.29730v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Bias in AI systems is typically framed as a flaw to be minimized, yet it also serves as a critical indicator of underlying weaknesses in data, modeling assumptions, and system design. Existing approaches often treat bias as an isolated problem rather than as evidence that can strengthen verification and governance across the AI lifecycle. This paper aims to reconceptualize bias as a diagnostic tool that supports rigorous AI verification. We seek to develop a multidimensional framework to analyze bias, demonstrate how biases emerge in both Traditi…
items.why_zh: 把偏见从“待消除的缺陷”转变为诊断与治理工具，为 AI 全生命周期的验证与设计成熟提供新思路。
items.why_en: It reframes bias from a defect to be minimized into a diagnostic instrument for verification and governance across the AI lifecycle.

items.title_zh: 幻觉神经元在哪里：对“幻觉神经元”存在性的考察
items.title_en: Hallucination Neurons and Where to Find Them: An Investigation into the existence of Hallucination Neurons
items.summary_zh: 面向大语言模型的可解释机器学习日益依赖稀疏探针方法，这类方法会识别出少量神经元，并声称它们能够检测甚至因果性地影响事实回忆、安全对齐和幻觉等行为。这些结论对模型审计与行为操控意义重大，却很少在 L1 正则化探针于相关高维特征空间中已知的失效模式下受到检验。作者提出一套五步诊断协议，涵盖特征相关性等内容，用以系统性地检验所谓“幻觉神经元”是否真实存在。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.29781v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Interpretable machine learning for Large Language Models (LLMs) increasingly relies on sparse probing methods that identify small sets of neurons claimed to detect and causally influence behaviors such as factuality recall, safety alignment, and hallucination. These claims have important implications for model auditing and behavioral steering, yet they are rarely tested against known failure modes of $L_1$-regularized probing in correlated, high-dimensional feature spaces. We propose a five-step diagnostic protocol covering feature correlation, b…
items.why_zh: 对“幻觉神经元”这类流行的可解释性结论提出系统性检验方法，关系到模型审计与行为引导的可靠性。
items.why_en: It subjects popular claims about hallucination neurons to systematic scrutiny, which matters for trustworthy model auditing and behavioral steering.

items.title_zh: 让模型学会提出有科学影响力的研究构想
items.title_en: Learning to Ideate for Scientific Impact
items.summary_zh: 科学创意生成正越来越多地由大语言模型承担，但现有系统通常只以新颖性、清晰度和可行性等“可立即评判”的指标来训练与评估，因而无法回答：科学界滞后的接受信号能否作为反馈，把模型引向预期影响力更高的研究方向。为此，作者把引用归一化后的影响力作为学术接受度的一种有噪声但可规模化的代理指标，并从超过 10 万篇计算机科学论文构建大规模数据集开展研究。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.29802v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Scientific ideation is increasingly mediated by large language models, but current ideation systems are usually trained and evaluated on immediately judgeable proxies such as novelty, clarity, and feasibility. This leaves open whether delayed signals of scientific uptake can be used as feedback for steering models toward research directions with higher expected \emph{impact}. We study this question using citation-normalized impact as a noisy but scalable proxy for scholarly uptake. We construct a large-scale dataset from over 100K computer scienc…
items.why_zh: 若滞后的引用等影响力信号可用于反馈，研究构想生成就有望从“看起来新颖”转向“真正有影响”。
items.why_en: If delayed signals like citations can serve as feedback, idea generation could shift from merely looking novel to producing genuinely impactful research.

items.title_zh: 用脑电解码想象语音：严格的受试者独立评估
items.title_en: Decoding Imagined Speech: A Strictly Subject-Independent Approach Using EEG
items.summary_zh: 从脑电（EEG）解码想象语音，被视为重度运动障碍者潜在的沟通途径，但已有研究报告的性能往往依赖不能清楚反映跨受试者泛化能力的评估协议。本研究在一个多类想象语音 EEG 数据集上采用严格受试者独立的评估框架，给出透明的基线调查，并比较了两套预处理与特征提取流程，其中一套基于时域统计特征。作者希望以此为该任务真实泛化能力提供更清晰的参照。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.29820v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Imagined speech decoding from electroencephalography (EEG) has gained increasing attention as a potential communication pathway for individuals with severe motor impairments, yet reported performance often relies on evaluation protocols that do not clearly reflect cross-subject generalization. This study presents a transparent baseline investigation of a multi-class imagined speech EEG dataset under a strictly subject-independent evaluation framework. Two preprocessing and feature extraction pipelines were compared: a time-domain statistical feat…
items.why_zh: 透明的跨受试者独立评估有助于判断想象语音解码是否真能走向通用、可部署的沟通辅助。
items.why_en: Transparent subject-independent evaluation is key to knowing whether imagined-speech decoding can become a generalizable, deployable communication aid.

items.title_zh: 智能体何时可以忘掉自己的推理？面向长程智能体的上下文压缩
items.title_en: When Can Agents Forget Their Reasoning? ICLR for Long-Horizon Agent Context Compression
items.summary_zh: 长程语言模型智能体在运行中不断累积推理历史，即便早先的决策已被执行和观察，上下文长度与推理开销仍持续增长。与静态的思维链压缩不同，删掉历史推理可能改变未来动作，进而改变整个交互轨迹。作者因此研究“推理何时可以被安全遗忘”，并提出 ICLR（Interaction Aware Compression for Long Horizon Reasoning）：一种免训练的在线方法，用冻结模型的代理熵对推理块进行排序。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.29875v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Long horizon language model agents continually accumulate reasoning history, increasing context length and inference cost even after earlier decisions have been executed and observed. Unlike static Chain of Thought compression, removing historical reasoning can change future actions and the resulting interaction trajectory. We study when such reasoning can be safely forgotten. We propose Interaction Aware Compression for Long Horizon Reasoning (ICLR), a training free online method that ranks reasoning blocks using frozen proxy entropy while prese…
items.why_zh: 在尽量不改变行为的前提下压缩推理历史，是降低长程智能体推理成本的关键。
items.why_en: Compressing reasoning history without altering behavior is central to cutting the inference cost of long-horizon agents.

items.title_zh: 面向多方利益相关者的本体中介神经符号约束获取
items.title_en: Ontology-Mediated Neurosymbolic Constraint Acquisition from Multiple Stakeholders
items.summary_zh: 神经符号研究通常假设符号规范已经存在，而如何获取并形式化需求与约束这一上游难题仍少有涉及。本文提出一种架构来填补这一空白：用 OWL 配置本体在神经约束来源与下游消费者之间充当中介。在该框架中，LLM 助手负责引出利益相关者的软性偏好，硬件规格则给出物理与工程上的硬性限制，本体把这两类异构输入统一起来。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.29876v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Neurosymbolic research typically assumes a pre-existing symbolic specification, leaving the upstream challenge of acquiring and formalizing requirements and constraints largely unaddressed. We present an architecture that fills this gap by using an OWL configuration ontology to mediate between neural constraint sources and downstream consumers. In this framework, LLM assistants elicit soft stakeholder preferences, while hardware specifications define hard physical and engineering limits. The ontology unifies these heterogeneous inputs, leverages…
items.why_zh: 把本体引入神经符号流程的上游，有望让从多方需求到可执行约束的获取过程更可管理。
items.why_en: Bringing ontologies into the upstream of neurosymbolic pipelines could make turning multi-stakeholder requirements into executable constraints far more manageable.

items.title_zh: Qwen-Planner-Agent：面向真实移动端规划智能体的闭环 AI-for-AI 框架
items.title_en: Qwen-Planner-Agent: A Closed-Loop AI-for-AI Framework for Real-World Mobile Planner Agents
items.summary_zh: 随着大语言模型从被动内容生成延伸到工程与科学发现的主动工作流，一个引人关注的问题浮现出来：AI 能否既是开发的对象，又是构建下一代 AI 系统的主动参与者？作者通过构建 Qwen-Planner-Agent，在一个闭环的 AI-for-AI 框架中探索可规模化的开发与迭代改进。移动端规划是这一思路的严苛试炼场，其复杂的长程任务对该框架提出了很高要求。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.29892v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The rapid progression of large language models is extending AI from passive content generation into the active workflows of engineering and scientific discovery. This shift raises a compelling question: can AI be both the object of development and an active participant in building next-generation AI systems? We explore this question by building Qwen-Planner-Agent within a closed-loop AI-for-AI framework for scalable development and iterative improvement. Mobile planning offers a demanding test of this approach: complex, long-horizon tasks challen…
items.why_zh: 若 AI 能参与自身系统的开发与迭代，AI-for-AI 闭环或将显著加快下一代智能体的研发。
items.why_en: If AI can help build and iteratively improve its own systems, closed-loop AI-for-AI could markedly accelerate the development of next-generation agents.
